description: Send Plinth events to a URL (your bot, Slack, Discord, Telegram, Zapier...). Events: deploy.succeeded, deploy.failed, approval.requested, approval.decided, app.down, app.up, support.created, support.replied, charge.succeeded, signup.approved. Leave events empty for all. Payloads are JSON with a "text" summary and an x-plinth-signature HMAC header; Slack/Discord webhook URLs and Telegram sendMessage URLs work as-is.

authorization.description: Optional Authorization header value, e.g. "Bearer abc". Stored encrypted.

name: webhooks.add
